principle: Rules classify mechanically enumerated company universes. T2 chains are direct recall; T1 chains are conditional recall and require stricter company-level earnings confirmation. Aggregate T1 parent chains may delegate to a more specific active child chain to avoid duplicate candidates. Rules never promote industry status. For configured unconfirmed chains, reverse-trigger audit scans the full currently verified exposed-company set rather than a hand-picked trigger name; strong company signals only reopen industry review.
